faq_current.question: What is Pokecut and what can I use it for?
faq_current.answer: Pokecut is an all-in-one AI photo editing platform for portraits, travel photos, product images, and creative content. You can remove backgrounds, erase objects, enhance image, create collages, use templates, and generate AI images.

Account & Access.firstAnswer: After entering the Pokecut website, you will be prompted at the top whether you need to change the language. Click to quickly change to your language. You also can slide the page to the bottom, then click on the Language button in the lower left corner to switch languages.

Commercial, Safety & Support.firstAnswer: Yes, you can. Pokecut allows you to use the images generated by Pokecut's AI Image Editor and AI Image Generator for commercial purposes. But please note that if the image contains design resources not provided by Pokecut, the relevant commercial copyright is not managed by Pokecut. For more information, please refer to our Terms of Use.
